headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty extended their winning streak to four weeks despite global AI selloff pressure.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Sensex and Nifty extended their weekly winning streak to 4 weeks with gains of around 3% supported by record FII buying.
Global selloff in AI stocks weighed heavily on market sentiment during recent sessions.
Federal Reserve signals regarding potential rate hikes created early-session pressure.
Banking, auto, and IT stocks supported market recovery during late trading sessions.
whatHappening: Ashok Leyland announced plans to establish a new truck plant in Singur, West Bengal.
Industrial metals and precious commodities including gold, copper, and aluminium fell to multi-month lows.
Google pledged $5 million to IIT Kharagpur for AI research and talent development in India.
Lam Research intensified its focus on the Indian semiconductor market amidst fab discussions.
summary: Indian benchmark indices extended their winning streak to four weeks, with Sensex and Nifty gaining around 3% driven by strong FII buying. Despite global AI selloffs and hawkish Fed signals inducing early-session declines, banking and IT stocks led intraday recoveries. Meanwhile, commodities experienced sharp drops with gold and industrial metals hitting multi-month lows.
